before: Savannah Highway (US-17) through West Ashley is a high-risk corridor for truck accidents due to narrow lanes, heavy commercial traffic, and limited-access intersections. Trucking companies and drivers must comply with federal regulations including hours-of-service limits, weight restrictions, and maintenance requirements — violations of which establish liability. Multiple parties may be at fault including the driver, trucking company, cargo loader, or vehicle manufacturer. South Carolina's modified comparative fault rule bars recovery at 51% or more fault, and the three-year filing deadline (S.C. Code SS 15-3-530) applies.
